node.title: Re: Replace a Hex Value in Column
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
<c>
#!/usr/bin/env perl
use warnings;
use strict;
use Text::CSV; # also install Text::CSV_XS for speed

my $infilename  = 'in.csv';
my $outfilename = 'out.csv';

my $csv = Text::CSV->new({ binary=>1, auto_diag=>2,
	eol=>$/, quote_char=>'"', sep_char=>";", always_quote=>1 });
open my $ifh, '<', $infilename  or die "$infilename: $!";
open my $ofh, '>', $outfilename or die "$outfilename: $!";
while ( my $row = $csv->getline($ifh) ) {
	$row->[5] = "BitTorrent";
	$csv->print($ofh, $row);
}
$csv->eof or $csv->error_diag;
close $ifh;
close $ofh;
</c>
